candidates.name: Chris Pappas
candidates.bio: U.S. representative for New Hampshire's 1st District since 2019.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Pappas cosponsored the Women's Health Protection Act (H.R. 3755, 2021), barring government restrictions on abortion access
guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Pappas voted for the 2022 clean energy investments (House roll call 420)

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Pappas calls for innovative solutions to the climate crisis
guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Pappas cosponsored H.R. 3184 to fund training and recruitment for small and midsize police departments
guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Pappas voted for the 2021 George Floyd Justice in Policing Act, which required body cameras (House roll call 60)
guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Pappas voted for the 2021 George Floyd Justice in Policing Act, which banned racial profiling and limited qualified immunity
guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Pappas introduced a bill funding substance use treatment and prevention (H.R. 9759)
guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Pappas introduced a bill banning companies from using surveillance pricing to raise food prices
guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Pappas on public schools

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Pappas says he has stood firm against efforts to dismantle public education

guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Pappas introduced a bill to hold polluters accountable for PFAS contamination (H.R. 6668) and voted to keep mining limits near the Boundary Waters (2026)

guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Pappas would make the ACA premium tax credits permanent
guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Pappas supports more enforcement against people who cross the border illegally and commit serious crimes

guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Pappas cosponsored the PRO Act (H.R. 842, 2021) and H.R. 2550 restoring federal workers' bargaining rights

guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Pappas voted against barring transgender students from girls' sports (House roll call 12, 2025) and cosponsored restoring the LGBTQ+ youth crisis line (H.R. 5434)

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Pappas voted three times against proof-of-citizenship registration requirements and opposes New Hampshire's ban on student IDs for voting

candidates.name: John E. Sununu
candidates.bio: U.S. senator for New Hampshire from 2003 to 2009 and U.S. representative from 1997 to 2003.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Sununu says abortion is a state issue and would not undermine New Hampshire's law, which allows abortion up to 24 weeks

guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Sununu would not override New Hampshire's abortion law federally; in 2006 he voted to make taking a minor across state lines for an abortion a federal crime
guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Sununu supports increasing domestic oil and gas production
source.quote: We need to protect [U.S.] energy dominance.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Sununu called the Inflation Reduction Act's climate and clean energy funding reckless spending
guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Sununu would expand nuclear power in New Hampshire

guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Sununu sponsored national pollutant limits in 2007 (S. 1177) and expanded White Mountain wilderness in 2006, and now backs permitting reform for transmission lines and pipelines
guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Sununu supports the 2025 law's cuts to government programs
guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Sununu supports New Hampshire's universal Education Freedom Accounts
source.quote: It puts money and power in the hands of the parent.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Sununu supports the 2025 Medicaid cuts and work requirements
guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Sununu says the ACA premium subsidies were meant to expire
guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Sununu would loosen federal health regulations and expand health savings accounts
guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Sununu says people here illegally who commit crimes should be deported
guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Sununu supports legal immigration programs and would work to fix them
guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Sununu says the U.S. needs seasonal workers
guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Sununu says presidents have the right to defend what they see as national security interests
guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Sununu says he would not have started the Iran war but defends the president's right to act
source.quote: If you're asking me if I would have done this, no

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Sununu praised the Supreme Court ruling upholding bans on transgender athletes in girls' sports (2026)
guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Sununu opposed raising the federal minimum wage (2005)
source.quote: pricing some workers out of the market

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate voters guide: Sununu supports extending the 2017 tax cuts

candidates.name: Kelly Ayotte
candidates.bio: Governor of New Hampshire since 2025, U.S. senator from 2011 to 2017 and earlier state attorney general.

source.title: NHPR and New Hampshire Bulletin, July 3, 2026: Ayotte pledged to veto any further abortion restrictions and in 2026 vetoed a bill on abortion conscience objections
Valley News, June 11, 2025: Ayotte signed SB 295, making Education Freedom Accounts universal (June 2025)
Concord Monitor, June 12, 2026: Ayotte signed a law tightening what she calls a broken bail system
WCAX, Oct. 7, 2026: Ayotte signed a dozen bills to increase housing, including regulatory changes
NHPR and New Hampshire Bulletin, July 3, 2026: Ayotte vetoed a bill letting landlords demand an extra month's deposit from low-income tenants (2026)
WCAX, Oct. 7, 2026: Ayotte backed child care tax credits
Concord Monitor, June 12, 2026: Ayotte increased benefits for law enforcement
Concord Monitor, June 12, 2026: Ayotte directed more money to mental health care
New Hampshire Bulletin, April 6, 2026: Ayotte signed a bill barring the use of student IDs to vote (2026)
NHPR via WBUR, Aug. 4, 2025: Ayotte signed HB 377, barring puberty blockers and hormone treatment for gender transition before 18 (Aug. 2025)
source.quote: these bills represent a balanced, bipartisan effort to protect children

source.title: NHPR, May 23, 2025: Ayotte signed HB 511 and SB 62, requiring local police to cooperate with federal immigration enforcement (May 2025)
